reviewScope.lexicalSelection: Actual vocabulary; no artificial numbered filler, same spelling is not counted again for another part of speech. Multiword terms are counted as one vocabulary entry.
reviewScope.meaningExampleTranslation: All entries authored/re-edited and editorially reviewed by the assistant; not independently reviewed by a human lexicographer.
reviewScope.pronunciation: CMU ARPAbet lookup, explicit phone-to-IPA conversion, part-of-speech variant selection, visual editorial pass, recorded source exceptions. Phrase components and regular inflections identified separately.
